packageRules.description: Automerge non-major cargo updates once required CI passes. The gate is the required check `build` (cargo-test-and-lint.yml), which covers every Cargo change since nothing Cargo-related is in its paths-ignore. Majors stay manual: they have consistently needed code changes (tera v2 reworked the Tera::new() signature and dropped Tera::context). addLabels is mandatory alongside automerge — this repository requires one approving review and Renovate cannot approve its own PR, so renovate-runner's approve-bot-prs workflow keys off the automerge label. Without the label no approval arrives and automerge waits forever.
tracing-opentelemetry is built against exactly one opentelemetry minor, so a bump of either alone does not compile. Grouped, the pull request simply waits until both have released.
